meta.conventions: CM = end-of-day UTC close; API = ~00:00 UTC snapshot. Pairs are always within one source.

hype_splice.note: CM returns shifted +1d onto the API grid; see build_unified_hype docstring

LIT_lighter.note: LIT (Lighter) has only 7 daily reference prices (2026-05-18..24) in accessible data; the rest are sparse anchors. No statistical lead-lag test is possible.
